name: InterContinental Hanoi Landmark72
positioning: High-rise luxury hotel atop the Landmark72 Tower in Hanoi's new Central Business District, with panoramic city views from every room
best_for: Travelers who want sweeping views of Hanoi from a skyscraper hotel
Business travelers basing themselves in Hanoi's new Central Business District

facts.text: The hotel sits atop the Landmark72 Tower in Hanoi's new Central Business District.
Rooms have a deep-soak bathtub and a walk-in rain shower.
Premium Rooms may include a daybed.
The outdoor pool is on the 7th floor of the building.
Guests have access to yoga and Zumba classes, table tennis, indoor mini golf, a sauna and a hot tub on the 7th floor.
In-house guests have access to a 24-hour, fully equipped gym on the 71st floor.
The hotel's five restaurants and bars are on the 62nd floor of the Landmark72 building.
Q Bar is a speakeasy-style cocktail bar inspired by the O Quy Ho Pass in northern Vietnam.
The Vietnam Museum of Ethnology is about 4 kilometers from the hotel.
Noi Bai International Airport is about 25 kilometers from the hotel.
Complimentary parking is available for hotel guests.

highlights.text: The hotel is the highest luxury hotel in Hanoi.
All rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic views of Hanoi.
The Club InterContinental Lounge is on the 71st floor and is the largest in Southeast Asia.
The outdoor pool looks out over the city skyline.
The concierge can arrange trips to Ha Long Bay and Van Long Wetland Nature Reserve.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the hotel is located away from Hanoi's historic Old Quarter.
Club Lounge access is for guests booking Club InterContinental rooms and suites, and InterContinental Royal Ambassadors.
The outdoor pool is on the 7th floor, not at the top of the tower.
